description: x402 metered API seller for Trinity Guardian (ETHGlobal Tokyo 2026). Ports the verified POC seller.ts to the real build with @x402/express paymentMiddleware on Base Sepolia via the x402.org facilitator, plus a new /merchants metadata endpoint so the UI can render a seller picker with spam/legit distinction. Standalone service — no dependencies on other tasks; merge first. SRS: FR-60..FR-62 (demo endpoints), FR-50 (merchants metadata for UI).

userStories.title: Express server with @x402 paymentMiddleware
userStories.description: As an agent, I want a metered API that returns 402 with payment requirements, so I can pay per-request via x402.
acceptanceCriteria: src/seller/index.ts boots Express with paymentMiddleware from @x402/express
x402ResourceServer registered for eip155:84532 with ExactEvmScheme
HTTPFacilitatorClient points to https://x402.org/facilitator
curl http://localhost:4020/weather returns 402 with Payment-Required header
Decoded header matches v2 schema: { x402Version: 2, resource: {...}, accepts: [...] }
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Port from POC seller.ts (verified E2E). Env: PORT=4020 default.

userStories.title: Three demo endpoints with correct pricing and payTo
userStories.description: As a presenter, I want 3 endpoints covering the 3 demo scenarios (clean, block, over-cap) so each Guardian layer has a trigger.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /weather?city= — $0.01 (10000 units) → SELLER_ADDRESS_A, returns { city, tempC, forecast }
GET /data — $0.25 (250000 units) → SELLER_ADDRESS_B, returns { dataset, rows }
GET /compute — $7.00 (7000000 units) → SELLER_ADDRESS_A, returns { result, model }
All accepts use network eip155:84532
Prices and payTo verified via decoded 402 headers
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: FR-60, FR-61, FR-62. Env: SELLER_ADDRESS_A (safe), SELLER_ADDRESS_B (flagged).

userStories.title: /merchants endpoint with spam metadata
userStories.description: As a UI dashboard, I want a list of merchants with name, description, price, address, and spam flag, so I can render risk legibly BEFORE the user pays.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /merchants (no auth) returns MerchantsResponse { merchants: MerchantInfo[] }
MerchantInfo: { id, name, description, address, isSpam, spamReason?, endpoints: EndpointInfo[] }
EndpointInfo: { path, method, price ('$0.01'), priceUnits ('10000'), description }
Two merchants: merchant-safe (Weather API, isSpam: false) and merchant-spam (Premium Data, isSpam: true, spamReason set)
Addresses match SELLER_ADDRESS_A/B from env
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Primary new feature vs POC. UI task consumes this for the SellerPicker screen.

userStories.title: Env-based config and types module
userStories.description: As a developer, I want clean env-driven config and exported types so other tasks can import seller types without runtime coupling.
acceptanceCriteria: src/seller/config.ts resolves SELLER_ADDRESS_A/B + PORT from env, throws with clear message if missing
src/seller/types.ts exports MerchantInfo, EndpointInfo, MerchantsResponse
Recycle mode preserved: SELLER_ADDRESS_A empty → agent wallet (optional nicety, not required)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Types are the contract for task-ui imports.
